Title: Fix: sap.m.Table horizontal scroll jitter on iPad Safari
Workaround: Disable sticky headers on iPad; selection stable but UX degraded
ReproSteps:
1) Login as sales_rep on iPad Safari
2) Orders > Order #12345 > Items
3) Horizontal-scroll quickly, then tap a row checkbox
4) Observe header jitter and selection offset
Notes: Renderer triggers layout thrash; prototype RAF throttling reduces jitter.

Messages.text: Jitter visible in pilot demo; impacts checkbox accuracy. Need clarity if this is fixed before Monday.
Workaround applied (sticky headers off on iPad). Reduces urgency slightly; functional path OK.
Messages.idea: Exploring RAF throttling + defer DOM writes post-scroll.

Messages.text: Two options: submit fix by Fri 10/10 (hotfix slot A) -> deliver to pilot Sat 10/11; or submit Tue 10/14 (slot B) -> deliver Thu 10/16.
Monday demo can proceed with workaround, but production rollout preferred by 10/16 latest.
Root cause isolated (layout thrash on scroll/selection). Prototype fix stabilizes UI on iPad; E2E flakiness remains.
Messages.idea: Replace DOM writes in onAfterRendering; add iPad OPA5 test; consider sticky header debounce.

Messages.text: Confirming decision needed today: Slot A (submit 10/10, deliver 10/11) vs Slot B (submit 10/14, deliver 10/16).
Leaning Slot A; if E2E remains flaky, fallback to Slot B is acceptable without customer impact.
Messages.idea: Gate with feature flag ui.table.stickyHeaders.iosFix for pilot-only enablement.
